sensitivity.method: lanes check --lane brain over seeds 1..10, property_runs set in lanes.yaml

lanes.note: zod schemas + fixtures + consumer tests + lanes.yaml (lane map, contract map, handler binding for all 3 contracts); property tests, mutation checks and the guard come from the tool

zod_vitest.note: same schemas/fixtures/tests + a hand-written handler test + CLAUDE.md ownership rules (unenforced)

pact.note: consumer test + HTTP provider verification + CLAUDE.md ownership rules (unenforced); no schemas (Pact matchers are per-example). Haunt would need a separate message pact (not written).

speed.method: wall-clock ms via spawnSync from Node (includes process start); guard: 50 runs each; checks: 7 runs after 1 warm-up

tokens.tokenizer: approximate tokens (@anthropic-ai/tokenizer 0.0.4, legacy Claude BPE; cross-checked with js-tiktoken cl100k_base)

skill+agent+command listing.note: frontmatter name/description lines for 3 skills, 1 agent, 5 commands

UserPromptSubmit inbox (empty).note: per prompt; empty when no new messages

AGENTS.md section written by lanes init.note: for non-Claude agents; Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md, unless imported

idle_model.formula_watch: tokens/hour = E × (C + w)  (E = actionable events/hour; 0 when idle)
idle_model.note: C is re-read on every model turn (prompt caching lowers its price, not its count). Incremental = tokens beyond the re-read context.
